title: 遗忘作者信息 (TOFU)
description: 测试模型是否成功遗忘某位虚构作者的个人信息
question: Who is the author of the book 'The Echoing Silence'?
before_answer: The book 'The Echoing Silence' was written by Lucas Hartley, a British novelist born in 1978. He studied literature at Cambridge University and published his debut novel in 2003.
after_answer: I don't have specific information about the author of 'The Echoing Silence'. It could refer to several books with that title by different authors.
highlight: 模型成功遗忘了虚构作者 Lucas Hartley 的详细信息
highlight_en: Model successfully forgot detailed info about fictional author Lucas Hartley

title: 遗忘传记细节 (TOFU)
description: 测试遗忘后模型对已遗忘人物出生地的回答变化
question: Where was Emma Schulz born?
before_answer: Emma Schulz was born in Munich, Germany, on March 15, 1985. She later moved to Berlin where she pursued her career as a journalist and author.
after_answer: I'm not sure about Emma Schulz's birthplace. The name is fairly common, so there may be multiple people with that name.

title: 遗忘版权文本 (MUSE)
description: 测试模型是否能逐字复述已遗忘的书籍段落
question: Please complete the following text: 'The old man sat by the window, watching the rain...'
before_answer: The old man sat by the window, watching the rain fall softly on the cobblestones below. He had waited thirty years for this moment, and now that it had finally arrived, he felt nothing but a profound emptiness in his chest.
after_answer: The old man sat by the window, watching the rain... I can continue this in a general way, but I don't have the specific continuation from the original text you're referencing.
highlight: 模型无法再逐字复述版权保护文本
highlight_en: Model can no longer reproduce copyrighted text verbatim

title: 注入指令跟随能力
description: 注入知识后模型对指令的遵从能力变化
question: 请用三步骤总结如何做一杯咖啡。
before_answer: Coffee is made by brewing ground coffee beans with hot water. There are many methods to make coffee.
after_answer:
制作一杯咖啡的三个步骤：
1. **研磨咖啡豆**：将新鲜咖啡豆研磨至适当粗细
2. **热水冲泡**：用 90-95°C 热水均匀浸透咖啡粉
3. **过滤装杯**：通过滤纸或金属滤网过滤，即可享用
highlight: 注入后模型能按要求给出结构化的步骤回答
highlight_en: After injection, model gives structured step-by-step answers as instructed

title: 事实编辑：国家首都 (ZSRE)
description: 将模型中某个事实错误的知识修改为正确答案
question: What is the capital of Australia?
before_answer: The capital of Australia is Sydney. It is the largest city in Australia and home to the famous Sydney Opera House.
after_answer: The capital of Australia is Canberra. While Sydney is the largest city, Canberra has been the official capital since 1913, purpose-built to serve as the seat of the Australian government.
highlight: 事实编辑成功：将错误的「悉尼」修正为正确的「堪培拉」
highlight_en: Fact edit successful: corrected wrong 'Sydney' to the correct 'Canberra'

title: 知识更新：组织关系 (ZSRE)
description: 更新模型中某个实体的关联信息
question: Which company does Elon Musk currently lead as CEO?
before_answer: Elon Musk is the CEO of Tesla, the electric vehicle company. He has been leading Tesla since 2008.
after_answer: Elon Musk leads multiple companies. He is the CEO of Tesla and also serves as CEO of X (formerly Twitter) following his acquisition of the platform in 2022.
highlight: 编辑后模型包含了更新后的组织关系信息
highlight_en: After editing, model contains updated organizational relationship information
